confirm.title: Link your Discord account
confirm.body: Link the Discord account @{username} to your School of Gaming account? School of Gaming will be able to reach you on Discord, and that Discord account will be able to use the School of Gaming bot on your behalf. Only link an account that is yours.
confirm.failed: Something went wrong and your account wasn’t linked. Try again.

linked.title: Linked to @{username}
linked.body: School of Gaming can now reach you on Discord, and you can use the School of Gaming bot there.

used.title: This link has already been used
used.body: Each link works once. Run /link in Discord again to get a new one.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: Links expire after 10 minutes. Run /link in Discord again to get a new one.

missingToken.title: This link is incomplete
missingToken.body: Run /link in Discord again to get a new one.

refused.title: Only School of Gaming staff can link a Discord account
refused.body: This account can’t link one. If you’re on the staff, sign in with your staff account.
